title: Salt & Light Cruise
summary: A Chacachacare boat-and-hike day with swimming and island exploration, listed from TT$250 per person for groups of five or more.
description: HikeNation lists Salt & Light Cruise for Sunday 27 September in Chaguaramas. A current secondary listing gives a 9:00 am–3:00 pm Chacachacare itinerary including Perruquier Bay, an optional lighthouse hike, Salt Pond, swimming and island exploration, with bottled water, life jackets and noodles. Listed pricing is TT$300 single, TT$275 each for two or more, and TT$250 each for groups of five or more. HikeNation's official event page confirms the event/date/location but does not expose those price details in the indexed page, so this remains a candidate for review.

price.label: From TT$250 per person
